shared_elements: anthropomorphic form rendered in stone as a monolithic upright block
justification: A is a three-dimensional human-like bust with a prominent eye, cheek and schematic arms, while B is a flat-faced upright slab covered in low-relief animals (a bird-headed creature, a fox-like quadruped, a large bird at the base) beneath a horizontal band of repeated H-like and rectangular signs. The only real correspondence is the shared idea of an abstracted anthropomorphic upright monolith with schematic arms/hands and emphatic facial or head features; the relief menagerie and register band of B have no counterpart in A, and A's fully carved head has no counterpart in B.
